newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 24.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Regional police chiefs meet in Abidjan to discuss strategy for fight against cross-border trade in narcotics.
- British trade mission visits Ivory Coast. Deputy-president of Ivorian Chamber of Commerce, Georges N'Dia Coffi, says at reception: "Ivory Coast is open to all investors wherever they come from."
_ Guinean officials backed by army demarcating their frontier inside Guizreu forest, which is in Ivorian territory, reports paper's correspondent in story headlined: Provocation.
- Parents of street children could be brought before courts under measures announced by Family Affairs Minister Albertine Gnanazan to rid streets of child beggars.
- Profits of commercial banks improving in seven West African states of the UEMOA trade group, regulator Commission Bancaire says in report.
